to Præcepto subjecta, ad vetus Testamen-

opponitur inscriptio Legum in cordibus,
quæ propriè competit Fœderi gratiæ; sed
minùs efficaciter & minùs copiosè obti-
nuit sub V.T. quàm deindè sub N.
